## Context

Why does this matter? What's the situation that makes this worth doing — not just what you want built, but the background someone with zero context needs to make good calls while implementing it.

## Current state

What exists today, concretely. Use real file:line references (`src/suggest.ts:42`, not "the suggest logic somewhere"). If this is a bug, a `GUESSWORK_DEBUG_LOG` capture (see README's Configuration table) is the equivalent of a real reference — attach it. If you haven't looked at the actual code/log yet, look before filing — this section shouldn't be guesswork.

## Proposed change / acceptance criteria

A checklist, not a paragraph:

- [ ] ...
- [ ] ...

## Edge cases and explicitly out of scope

What could go wrong, what NOT to do, and what this issue deliberately does not cover. Say so explicitly — "don't touch X while you're in here," "don't build Y, that's a separate issue" — rather than leaving it to be inferred.

## Related issues/PRs

Cross-link anything relevant.
